themes.title: Far-right push for 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across Europe are intensifying demands for 'national priority' policies, which prioritize native-born citizens for public services, housing, and social benefits. This theme is evident in Spain, Italy, and Sweden, where parties like Vox, Lega, and Sverigedemokraterna are leveraging local and regional elections to advance these policies, often clashing with coalition partners and opposition groups.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Demands 'national priority' in public services and housing, clashing with PSOE and PP over regional budgets and healthcare access for migrants.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Advocates for stricter immigration controls and prioritizing Italian citizens in social policies, often aligning with Vox's rhetoric.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Pushes for policies favoring Swedish citizens in welfare and housing, reflecting similar 'national priority' themes.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Proposes stricter immigration policies and prioritizing Norwegian citizens in public services.

themes.title: Javier Milei’s declining approval amid internal strife
themes.blurb: Argentina's President Javier Milei faces declining approval ratings and internal conflicts within his party, La Libertad Avanza. His government's economic policies, including austerity measures and deregulation, have sparked public backlash and protests. Internal divisions are exacerbated by high-profile resignations and public disputes with allies, including former supporters and coalition partners.

themes.title: Far-right gains in European local elections
themes.blurb: Far-right parties are making significant gains in local and regional elections across Europe, reflecting a broader trend of increasing support for nationalist and anti-establishment platforms. These gains are evident in Italy, Spain, Germany, and Sweden, where parties like Fratelli d'Italia, Vox, AfD, and Sverigedemokraterna are consolidating power and influencing local governance.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Gains in local elections, particularly in regions like Tuscany and Emilia-Romagna, where they consolidate power.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Increases influence in regional governments, particularly in Andalusia and Valencia, through coalition agreements with PP.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Makes gains in state elections, particularly in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern and Berlin, positioning itself as a major political force.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Strengthens its position in local councils, particularly in rural areas, by advocating for stricter immigration policies.

themes.title: Internal divisions within far-right parties
themes.blurb: Far-right parties across Europe and the Americas are experiencing internal divisions, with leadership challenges, ideological disputes, and public infighting. These divisions are evident in Poland, Hungary, the UK, France, and Argentina, where parties like PiS, Fidesz, Reform UK, Rassemblement National, and La Libertad Avanza are grappling with leadership crises and factionalism.

themes.title: EU and NATO tensions over Ukraine and Ebola
themes.blurb: Tensions between EU and NATO members over Ukraine's potential accession and responses to the Ebola outbreak are creating divisions among far-right and right-wing parties. These tensions are particularly evident in Italy, Poland, and Hungary, where parties like Fratelli d'Italia, PiS, and Fidesz are navigating complex geopolitical dynamics and public health concerns.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Balances NATO commitments with domestic pressures, particularly over Ukraine's EU accession and Ebola response.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Criticizes Ukraine's actions, particularly over historical disputes, while maintaining NATO alignment.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Navigates EU tensions over Ukraine and Ebola, often clashing with Brussels over rule-of-law and migration policies.
